verdict.rationale: Qodo reviews every pull request automatically and documents a centralized rule system for defining and enforcing engineering standards, including rules mined from PR history and governance applied across repositories. That is close to custom checks running on every PR. However, the evidence never shows rules written in plain language, never presents them as discrete pre-merge checks with pass/fail gating, and gives no examples like 'docs updated' or 'tests cover new paths'. Missing for 10: explicit plain-language custom check authoring, pass/fail merge-gating semantics, documented examples of check-style rules (docs/tests coverage), independent hands-on corroboration.
